Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From 11d8d645343efba0c975aefe7c2cf3b33c836c75 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Or Gerlitz <ogerlitz@mellanox.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Mar 2016 18:52:23 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] IB/core: Use GRH when the path hop-limit > 0

According to IBTA spec v1.3 section 12.7.19, QPs should use GRH when
the path returned by the SA has hop-limit > 0. Currently, we do that
only for the > 1 case, fix that.

Fixes: 6d969a471ba1 ('IB/sa: Add ib_init_ah_from_path()')
Signed-off-by: Or Gerlitz <ogerlitz@mellanox.com>
Reviewed-by: Jason Gunthorpe <jgunthorpe@obsidianresearch.com>
Signed-off-by: Doug Ledford <dledford@redhat.com>

diff --git a/drivers/infiniband/core/sa_query.c b/drivers/infiniband/core/sa_query.c
index f334090bb612..1e37f3515d98 100644
--- a/drivers/infiniband/core/sa_query.c
+++ b/drivers/infiniband/core/sa_query.c
@@ -1071,7 +1071,7 @@ int ib_init_ah_from_path(struct ib_device *device, u8 port_num,
 		}
 	}
 
-	if (rec->hop_limit > 1 || use_roce) {
+	if (rec->hop_limit > 0 || use_roce) {
 		ah_attr->ah_flags = IB_AH_GRH;
 		ah_attr->grh.dgid = rec->dgid;
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/infiniband/core/sa_query.c`**
   - The conditional check in the `ib_init_ah_from_path` function was modified. 
   - The original condition `if (rec->hop_limit > 1 || use_roce)` was changed to `if (rec->hop_limit > 0 || use_roce)`. 
   - This change ensures that the function will now use the Generic Route Header (GRH) when the hop limit is greater than 0, aligning with the IBTA specification.

### Relationships
- The modification in `sa_query.c` directly addresses a compliance issue with the IBTA specification regarding the use of GRH based on the hop limit. 
- The patch fixes a previously identified bug (referenced by the commit `6d969a471ba1`), which only allowed GRH usage for hop limits greater than 1. 
- By changing the condition to include hop limits greater than 0, the patch enhances the functionality of the `ib_init_ah_from_path` function, ensuring it adheres to the specified behavior in the IBTA documentation.
